scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-github-projects.mjs && node scripts/check-live-apps.mjs && node scripts/fetch-intro-films.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.intro:render: npm --prefix intro-film run render:landscape && npm --prefix intro-film run render:portrait
scripts.intro:build: npm run intro:prepare && npm run intro:render && npm run intro:publish && npm run intro:clean

scripts.intro:upload: gh release upload intro-films public/videos/intro/*.mp4 --repo maxmoneycash/terminal-portfolio --clobber
scripts.media:upload: gh release upload intro-films public/videos/reels/orbital-works-*.mp4 --repo maxmoneycash/terminal-portfolio --clobber
